test-fs-promises-file-handle-read-worker.reason: FileHandle cannot cross a worker transferList (DataCloneError) — structural: the shim's FileHandle wraps memfs state that is not transferable. Fails identically on pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-readdir-types.js.reason: All public assertions pass after the Dirent fix (instanceof fs.Dirent, correct types). Remaining failure is the test's white-box mock of Node's internal binding (internalBinding('fs').readdir mocked with mustCall(2), actual 0): a memfs-backed browser shim cannot route readdir through the native binding. Fails differently (earlier, on instanceof) on pristine base 1a89d258 — the public-behavior half is fixed.

test-fs-readdir-ucs2.js.reason: Expects byte-exact Buffer filenames for unpaired-surrogate paths, but memfs normalizes all paths through JS strings, so lone surrogates become U+FFFD on readdir. Preserving raw bytes would require a parallel byte-keyed namespace — rejected as too risky for the passing suite. Fails identically on pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-readfile-pipe-large.js.reason: Parent writes the input file via the shim (memfs-only); the child is fed via shell stdin redirect (child < file), which needs the file on real disk. The host shell cannot see the memfs volume. Fails identically on pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-readfilesync-pipe-large.js.reason: Same as test-fs-readfile-pipe-large.js: shell stdin redirect requires the memfs-only input file on real disk. Fails identically on pristine base 1a89d258.
